Distributed services mean distributed data 
Benefits
• Use purpose-built data stores 
compared to one do-it-all database.
• Optimize for access and query 
patterns.
• Scale databases independently.
Challenges
• Accept eventual consistency.
• Handle distributed transactions and 
partial completions.
• Plan appropriate extract, transform, 
and load (ETL) solutions.
